scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @yinghuo/contracts build && concurrently -k -n api,h5 "pnpm dev:server" "pnpm dev:client:h5"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @yinghuo/contracts build && pnpm --filter @yinghuo/server build && pnpm --filter @yinghuo/worker build && pnpm --filter @yinghuo/client build:h5 && pnpm --filter @yinghuo/admin build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @yinghuo/contracts build && pnpm --filter @yinghuo/server test && pnpm --filter @yinghuo/worker test
